categories.title: Meat of bovine animals, pig and poultry
categories.scope: Meat of bovine animals, pig and poultry. Keep this matrix distinct from other tissues and processed products.

categories.title: Meat of sheep
categories.scope: Meat of sheep. Keep this matrix distinct from other tissues and processed products.

categories.title: Offal of bovine animals, sheep, pig and poultry
categories.scope: Offal of bovine animals, sheep, pig and poultry. Keep this matrix distinct from other tissues and processed products.

categories.title: Game meat except bear
categories.scope: Bear meat is excluded.

categories.title: Game offal except bear
categories.scope: Bear offal is excluded.

categories.title: Fish muscle under Annex I 4.2.2.1.1
categories.scope: Also covers muscle of fish listed in 4.2.2.1.2 and 4.2.2.1.3 when intended for infant and young-child food production. Whole-fish basis applies when the fish is intended to be eaten whole.

categories.title: Listed fish muscle under Annex I 4.2.2.1.2
categories.scope: Only the species listed in this section and only when not intended for infant and young-child food production. Whole-fish basis applies when intended to be eaten whole. See the species list in docs/SOURCE-REVIEW.md.

categories.title: Listed fish muscle under Annex I 4.2.2.1.3
categories.scope: Only the species listed in this section and only when not intended for infant and young-child food production. Whole-fish basis applies when intended to be eaten whole. See the species list in docs/SOURCE-REVIEW.md.

categories.title: Crustaceans and bivalve molluscs
categories.scope: Crustaceans: muscle of appendages and abdomen, excluding cephalothorax. Crabs and similar crustaceans: appendage muscle only. Pecten maximus: adductor muscle and gonad only. Canned crustaceans: entire can contents. Composite-product provisions in Article 3 remain applicable.

categories.title: Eggs
categories.scope: Do not silently extend the egg value to formula, dairy or other food matrices.

categories.title: Carpets and rugs
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of carpets or rugs; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Cleaning products
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of cleaning products; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Cookware and bakeware
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of cookware; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Cosmetics
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of cosmetics; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Dental floss
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of dental floss; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Fabric treatments
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of fabric treatments; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Juvenile products
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of juvenile products; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Menstruation products
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of menstruation products; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Textile furnishings
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of textile furnishings; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Ski wax
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of ski wax; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Upholstered furniture
categories.scope: Only items meeting the statutory definition of upholstered furniture; preserve component and medical exclusions. No eligibility is inferred merely from a retail category label.

categories.title: Drinking water from regulated supplies
categories.scope: Community and non-transient non-community systems for US source rows. EU water parameters remain unconfirmed from the primary directive. No transfer to bottled water.

categories.title: Bottled drinking water
categories.scope: Finished bottled water, with natural mineral water classification kept separate. Public-system MCLs are not automatically bottled-water law.

categories.title: Paper and board food packaging
categories.scope: Paper, board and plant-fiber food-contact articles. Migration, bulk organic fluorine and intentional use are separate endpoints.

categories.title: Other food packaging
categories.scope: Plastic tubs, films, coatings, metal, glass and closures require material-specific review. Paper rules do not establish numeric limits for these materials.

categories.title: Infant formula
categories.scope: Powder, concentrated liquid and ready-to-feed formulations remain separate product forms. Neither fish ingredient limits nor tap-water MCLs set a finished-formula ceiling.

categories.title: Baby food
categories.scope: Finished purees, cereals, snacks and mixed foods. Fish ingredient provisions require separate ingredient and processing review and do not supply a universal finished-food limit.

categories.title: Dairy and butter
categories.scope: Milk, powders, fermented milk, cheese, cream and butter. Do not transfer meat or egg values or dioxin limits into PFAS cells.

categories.title: Plant foods and beverages
categories.scope: Produce, cereals, coffee, chocolate and other plant foods. Monitoring or investigation levels are not automatically maximum levels.

categories.title: Pet food
categories.scope: Dry, wet, raw and other feed products remain separate from food for human consumption.

categories.title: Textiles and apparel
categories.scope: Clothing and outdoor apparel are not automatically textile furnishings or fabric treatments. Broader textile legislation is not exhaustively reviewed here.

categories.title: Toothpaste and other oral care
categories.scope: Finished toothpaste and oral-care products other than dental floss. Cosmetic, drug and medical classifications require product-specific review.

categories.title: Baby wipes, lotions and sunscreens
categories.scope: Formulation and intended use determine cosmetic, drug or other classification. No blanket import of a cosmetics prohibition or paper indicator.
